title: Reconciliation service gets the runtime-manager read credential
summary: docker-compose.yml wires PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN: runtime-control-internal to reconciliation-drift-svc, matching the incident service credential so scheduled reconciliation can query runtime-manager without 401/403 authorization failures on hosted environments.

acceptance_verification.description: docker-compose.yml gives reconciliation-drift-svc exactly one new environment entry PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN with the same value the incident service uses and changes nothing else
The reconciliation-drift compose activation test asserts that entry; the same assertion fails on the base
acceptance_verification.verdict: pass: test_compose_wires_reconciliation_drift_as_derived_read_model fails on base with KeyError: 'PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TOKEN' and passes with the entry added

acceptance_verification.description: The commit subject is at most 72 characters with LLM-Agent and Task-ID and Reviewer trailers; the branch is pushed and a PR to dev is open before handoff
